subject: general
question: Six people, A, B, C, D, E and F, are sitting in a row, facing north. Only two people sit to the left of F. Only one person sits between D and E. F sits to the immediate left of D. A sits to the immediate right of C. B sits third to the right of A. Who sits at the extreme left end of the line?
solution:
**Given:**

Six people A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting in a row facing north.

Only two people sit to the left of F.

Only one person sits between D and E.

F sits to the immediate left of D.

A sits to the immediate right of C.

B sits third to the right of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c20debfca9023f89ecd3dbdc645e59ba769c6a893887f76ce60d1b06b5f7437c.png] 

The person sitting at the extreme left end is **C**.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 3**.
